units.source_text: 当然，拜访金阁寺是我多年梦寐以求的。

en.t: Of course, visiting Kinkakuji had been something I had dreamed of for many years.

units.source_text: 即使父亲强作坚强，但是谁都可以看出他是个身患重病的人。

en.t: Even though my father forced himself to appear strong, anyone could see that he was gravely ill.

units.source_text: 我实在没有什么心思与他外出旅行。

en.t: I truly had no heart for going on a trip with him.

units.source_text: 未曾一睹的金阁越来越接近的时候，我心中便有点踌躇了。

en.t: As the Golden Pavilion, which I had never yet seen, drew closer and closer, I began to feel a little hesitant.

units.source_text: 不管怎么说，金阁都应该是美的。

en.t: Whatever else might be said, the Golden Pavilion ought to be beautiful.

units.source_text: 因而，这一切与其说是金阁本身的美，莫如说是我倾尽身心所想像的金阁的美。

en.t: Therefore, all of this was not so much the beauty of the Golden Pavilion itself as the beauty of the Golden Pavilion I had imagined with my whole body and soul.
